snippet.title: Quirk: 120+ Logic Puzzle Games | Trailer
snippet.description:
Download the app: www.playquirk.app

A little twist. A lot to solve. Quirk has 120+ puzzle types, and every puzzle has its own world and its own sounds. Every one can be solved with logic. No guessing.

Play Mini Sudoku, Tube Sort, Bridges, Tents, Light Up, Nonogram, Kakuro, Word Search and many more.

Free with ads. A one-time Ad-free purchase is available.

Real app footage.

#LogicPuzzles #PuzzleGames #Quirk
